_comment: Scenario for the clutter-edge CFAR evaluation (sweep_clutter_edge.py). The targets list is a TEMPLATE: only its first entry's `amplitude` is used by the sweep script; range_m and velocity_mps are overridden per sweep position. Target amplitude is chosen so the target peak sits comfortably above the clean-noise CFAR threshold but only marginally above the in-clutter threshold — that's the regime where CA/GO fail and OS/SO succeed (the test we want to run). The leakage_amplitude is also disabled (set to 0) so the range-0 column doesn't compete with clutter at non-zero ranges. Clutter regions themselves are set programmatically per --level by the sweep script.
